statements.venue: Letter to President Trump led by Rep. Tokuda, quoted in press release
statements.quote: If the United States gives our very best AI chips to China, it would exponentially increase their capacity to dominate the AI race
statements.context: A letter she led, with Rep. Ro Khanna and 13 other members, urging the President to keep strict export controls on advanced AI chips to China ahead of talks with Xi Jinping.
statements.reason: About competition with China and chip export controls, with no acknowledgment of catastrophic risk from AI (ruling 5).

slowdown.note: No statement found on slowing frontier AI for safety reasons; the letter's call to 'slow down China's AI progress' is about competition, not safety.

intl.note: No statement found on coordinating with China on the pace of AI; her letter urges withholding chips from China ahead of talks.
